WITH date_dim_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT date_dim.d_date_sk, date_dim.d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
customer_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer.c_customer_sk, customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name
    FROM customer
    GROUP BY customer.c_customer_sk, customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name
),
store_hot_cust AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_rows.c_last_name,
        customer_rows.c_first_name,
        date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered
        ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows
        ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer_rows.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_hot_cust AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_rows.c_last_name,
        customer_rows.c_first_name,
        date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered
        ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows
        ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer_rows.c_customer_sk
),
web_hot_cust AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        customer_rows.c_last_name,
        customer_rows.c_first_name,
        date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered
        ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_rows
        ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer_rows.c_customer_sk
),
all_hot_cust AS (
    SELECT
        store_hot_cust.c_last_name,
        store_hot_cust.c_first_name,
        store_hot_cust.d_date
    FROM store_hot_cust
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        catalog_hot_cust.c_last_name,
        catalog_hot_cust.c_first_name,
        catalog_hot_cust.d_date
    FROM catalog_hot_cust
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        web_hot_cust.c_last_name,
        web_hot_cust.c_first_name,
        web_hot_cust.d_date
    FROM web_hot_cust
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        all_hot_cust.c_last_name,
        all_hot_cust.c_first_name,
        all_hot_cust.d_date
    FROM all_hot_cust
    GROUP BY
        all_hot_cust.c_last_name,
        all_hot_cust.c_first_name,
        all_hot_cust.d_date
    HAVING count(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
